newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-RAIN DELAYS 4TH DAY OF NZ-ENGLAND TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN DELAYS 4TH DAY OF NZ-ENGLAND TEST.

text.p: Rain delayed the resumption of play on the fouth day of the second test between England and New Zealand on Sunday.
Earlier rain had prevented a prompt start and play was then set to begin 45 minutes late but then another heavy shower swept the ground.
The delay frustrated England's victory hopes with New Zealand in deep trouble, needing to bat for most of the last two days to save the match.
New Zealand were 48 without loss in their second innings, still requiring 211 to make England bat a second time.
The first test in the three-match series was drawn.
Scores: New Zealand 124 (D. Patel 45, D. Gough 5-40, A. Caddick 4-45) and 48 for no wicket; England 383 (G. Thorpe 108, N. Hussain 64, J. Crawley 56, A. Stewart 52, S. Doull 5-75).
